description: Download Button for Power BI provides users with a clear and accessible way to export report data without navigating through the visual header and its More options menu. Add the visual to your report, assign the columns or measures to export, and users can download the currently filtered data with a single click. 🔧 Key Features: One-Click CSV Export: Download the assigned data directly through a clearly visible button. Filter-Aware Downloads: Report, page and visual filters are automatically reflected in the exported data. Custom Export Fields: Report authors control which columns and measures are included in the CSV file. Custom Button Text: Change the button label to match the language or purpose of your report. Custom Filename: Define the filename used for the downloaded CSV file. CSS Styling: Apply custom CSS to match the button to your report design and organisation’s branding. Empty State Handling: Automatically disable the button when the filtered dataset contains no rows. Large Exports: Export up to 30,000 rows of data. This visual is open-source and free to use — always!
